observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: open-air paved plaza in front of a grand government-style building with palm trees and a flag under bright daylight
observation.dancers: mixed group of male and female dancers in traditional folk costumes; medium group size
observation.formation_and_space: starts with couples in spread positions, transitions into shifting circles, lines, and solo groupings moving across the plaza
observation.posture: upright torso, erect posture, knees slightly flexed to support balance
observation.footwork: quick rhythmic stepping matching the duple meter beat, exact foot placement obscured by long skirts and low resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: women hold and wave the edges of wide layered skirts outward; men use arms for balance or hold sashes/scarves
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains relatively upright and stable while hips sway gently with the stepping
observation.partnering: independent solo and grouped formation dancing rather than close partner holds
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent spinning turns; moments where female dancers drop to floor level while balancing objects on their heads
observation.costume_and_props: women wear colorful, wide-tiered ruffled dresses with black-trimmed conical structures balanced on their heads (bottles); men wear white shirts, trousers, hats, and patterned sashes
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details, weight distribution, and subtle individual steps are obscured by wide skirts, distance, and low-resolution camera framing

signature_moments.what: Dancers spin rapidly in circular formations with skirts extended wide.
Female dancers lower themselves to the ground while keeping bottles balanced upright on their heads.
A line of female dancers walks steadily forward in single file with stacked bottles balanced on their heads.
